name: recombyn
description: zuoge — open-source AI design workspace with a document-derived SoA infinite artboard and Design Agent

scripts.dev:infra: docker compose up -d mysql redis minio minio-init
scripts.check: turbo run lint --filter=@recombyn/web && turbo run typecheck --filter=@recombyn/contracts
scripts.ci:gate: npm run check && npm run typecheck:web && npm run test:web && npm run test:api:unit
scripts.test: npm run test:web && npm run test:api
scripts.test:functional: npm run test:functional:api && npm run test:functional:e2e
scripts.install:api: cd apps/api && pip install -e ../../packages/scene-builder-py && pip install -e ../../packages/protocol && pip install -e ../../packages/intelligence-client && pip install -e ../../packages/skill-sdk && pip install -e ../../packages/plugin-sdk && pip install -e ../../packages/agent-sdk && pip install -e ../../packages/billing-sdk && pip install -e ../../packages/runtime && pip install -e ".[dev]"
scripts.install:api:otel: cd apps/api && pip install -e ../../packages/scene-builder-py && pip install -e ../../packages/protocol && pip install -e ../../packages/intelligence-client && pip install -e ../../packages/skill-sdk && pip install -e ../../packages/plugin-sdk && pip install -e ../../packages/agent-sdk && pip install -e ../../packages/billing-sdk && pip install -e ../../packages/runtime && pip install -e ".[dev,otel]"
